about_short_description.short_description: Monto is a mobile application that offers employees the flexibility to access their earned wages on-demand before payday.

product.name: Salary On-Demand
product.description: Allows employees to access a portion of their earned wages before the official payday without interest or loans.

product.name: Variable Income On-Demand
product.description: Provides early access to variable pay components like commissions, bonuses, and benefits before payday.

product.name: Payroll Advances
product.description: Offers employees advances on a portion of their salary before payday, deducted from future payroll.

product.name: Payroll Loans
product.description: Provides credit loans to employees based on their recurring income, with fixed interest and repayment terms.

product.name: Employee Benefits Platform
product.description: A platform offering a range of employee benefits including discounts, health services, education, and loyalty programs.

product.name: Health and Wellness Services
product.description: Offers virtual medical consultations, wellness programs, and discounts on health-related products and services for employees and their families.
